data.code_commit_message:
fix(cpu): SIM-BUG-7 — move BZ/BHLEQ resolution from decode to fetch

BZ/BHLEQ branch condition was resolved in p_decode() using exec_to_mem
Z flag from instruction N-2. Hardware resolves in ALU stage using
p_alu_mem_z_2 (instruction N-1). Moved resolution to p_fetch() where
decode_to_exec holds BZ in EX stage and exec_to_mem correctly holds
instruction N-1's Z flag.

Also added plain sequential binary file format support (16-bit per line,
no address prefix) for loading hardware assembler output.
